## Courses taught at the Institute for Geoinformatics, 2010–2016

: Analysis of Spatio-Temporal Data, Institute for Geoinformatics, University of Münster.

SS 2015
: Matheergänzungskurs zur Linearen Algebra für Informatiker, Institute for Geoinformatics, University of Münster.
: Guest lecture on copulas and spatial copulas within *Advanced Geostatistics*, ITC -- Faculty of Geo-Information Science and Earth Observation, University of Twente, The Netherlands, 6 July 2015.

WS 2014/2015
: Matheergänzungskurs zur Analysis für Informatiker, Institute for Geoinformatics, University of Münster.

WS 2013/2014
: Lecture on spatio-temporal kriging within *Analysis of Spatio-Temporal Data*, Institute for Geoinformatics, University of Münster. The interactive exploration tool for spatio-temporal variogram surfaces is part of the [shiny apps](shiny-apps.qmd).

August 2013
: Copula Summer School: practical introduction to R with exercises, 19 August 2013.
